name: quotemem
description: Auditable long-term memory: saves the conversation every few turns, recalls memories with their source quotes when you ask about the past, and forgets on request, all without extra steps.

url.title: QuoteMem URL
url.description: Root URL of your QuoteMem service. Leave empty to use QUOTEMEM_URL, or http://127.0.0.1:8765.

token.title: QuoteMem token
token.description: The service's token, for a service on another computer. Leave empty for the service on this computer (its own token is read), or to use the file QUOTEMEM_TOKEN_FILE names.

user_id.title: Memory owner
user_id.description: Whose memory to use. Leave empty to use QUOTEMEM_USER_ID, or your OS user name; use the same value in every tool to share one memory.
